facts.fact: AICCRA reports that ANACIM, which fully runs the AgData Hub since late 2025, now generates crop-specific, district-scale agro-climatic bulletins combining near-real-time forecasts, satellite observations and seasonal outlooks.
AICCRA says the multidisciplinary working group coordinated by ANACIM publishes an agrometeorological bulletin at the end of each ten-day period, now produced in the AgData Hub app.
